axis_frame_length_adjust.summary: AXI-stream frame length adjuster: a 4-state FSM (idle/transfer/pad/truncate) uses min/max down-counters and a frame pointer to zero-pad short frames and truncate long ones, with a skid-buffered output and a status valid/ready report per frame.

blocks.name: length_fsm
blocks.description: Idle/transfer/pad/truncate controller driving datapath and status.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/TRANSFER/PAD/TRUNCATE controller selecting pass-through, zero padding or dropping.

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Load enable capturing last_word_* registers before pad or truncate.

anchors.name: word_cnt
anchors.why: Valid words in current beat from tkeep; compared with counters.

blocks.name: length_counters
blocks.description: Min/max remaining-length counters and frame pointer.

anchors.name: short_counter_reg
anchors.why: Bytes remaining to reach length_min; decides padding and pad end.

anchors.name: long_counter_reg
anchors.why: Bytes remaining before length_max; triggers truncation and final tkeep.

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Running frame byte count giving original and output frame length.

anchors.name: length_min
anchors.why: Minimum frame length loaded into short_counter.

anchors.name: length_max
anchors.why: Maximum frame length loaded into long_counter.

blocks.name: frame_datapath
blocks.description: Input masking, pad/truncate data selection and last-word holding registers.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Last kept word held during truncation; representative of last_word_* registers.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata_masked
anchors.why: Input data with tkeep-disabled lanes zeroed, forwarded to output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: FSM-selected output data: input, zero pad or held last word.

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep_int
anchors.why: Output keep mask trimmed to min/max length boundary.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal valid from FSM into the output skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input frame data, masked and forwarded.

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Input byte enables used for masking and word count.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; with ready advances counters and FSM.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from s_axis_tready_reg; dropped during padding.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of input frame deciding pad, truncate or status report.

blocks.name: output_skid_buffer
blocks.description: Output and temp registers forming an AXI-stream skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready advancing padding and output transfers.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data held while output is stalled.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp occupied flag affecting early ready and temp-to-output.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads output registers from internal datapath.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads skid temp registers when output stalls.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp registers into output registers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Adjusted output frame data from output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from m_axis_tvalid_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready steering output/temp register transfers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame including after padding.

blocks.name: status_report
blocks.description: Registered per-frame status with pad/truncate flags and lengths.

anchors.name: status_valid
anchors.why: Per-frame status report valid, held until status_ready.

anchors.name: status_ready
anchors.why: Status consumer ready; clears status_valid and gates new frame acceptance.

anchors.name: status_frame_pad
anchors.why: Reports that the frame was padded.

anchors.name: status_frame_truncate
anchors.why: Reports that the frame was truncated.

anchors.name: status_frame_length
anchors.why: Output frame length reported on status interface.

axis_fifo.summary: AXI-Stream FIFO: write logic stores packed beats into a RAM via write/commit pointers, a read pipeline fetches via rd pointer to the output port, with full/empty compare and depth/overflow status.

blocks.name: Write controller
blocks.description: Accepts input beats, writes mem, manages commit pointer and frame drop/mark logic.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem, incremented on accepted input beats.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer; frames become visible to reader once committed, used for empty.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready derived from full and drop/mark mode parameters.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: Pointer MSB compare; deasserts s_axis_tready and triggers drop/mark.

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: Frame overflow flag (frame mode only) forcing drop or send of oversize frame.

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Set while discarding the current frame; parameter-disabled in this config.

anchors.name: mark_frame_reg
anchors.why: Marks truncated frame bad via tlast/tuser override when full.

anchors.name: send_frame_reg
anchors.why: Forces commit of oversize frame beats in frame mode.

anchors.name: s_frame_reg
anchors.why: Tracks being inside an input frame for mark-when-full.

anchors.name: s_axis
anchors.why: Packed input word (data, tlast, tuser) written into mem.

blocks.name: FIFO RAM
blocks.description: Dual-pointer RAM storing packed stream beats.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Main FIFO RAM holding packed tdata/tlast/tuser beats.

blocks.name: Read pipeline
blocks.description: Reads mem through RAM pipeline registers and drives the output stream handshake.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer addressing mem, incremented when a beat enters the output pipeline.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: Commit pointer equals read pointer; blocks read pointer increment.

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: RAM read pipeline stages carrying beats from mem to the output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Valid chain for the read pipeline stages; bubbles allow advance.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_pipe
anchors.why: Ready into the read pipeline enabling stage transfers and reads.

anchors.name: m_axis
anchors.why: Packed output word from last pipeline stage unpacked into fields.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream payload from last RAM pipeline stage.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid driven from valid pipeline, optionally gated by pause.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready advancing the output pipeline and read pointer.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame unpacked from stored beat.

blocks.name: Status
blocks.description: Registered depth and frame-event status outputs.

anchors.name: status_depth
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy output from registered write-read pointer difference.

anchors.name: status_depth_commit
anchors.why: Committed occupancy output from commit pointer minus read pointer.

anchors.name: status_overflow
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped frame due to overflow.

anchors.name: status_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a dropped bad frame.

anchors.name: status_good_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a committed good frame.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input stream payload packed into s_axis and written to mem.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input valid; with tready triggers writes into mem.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input end-of-frame stored with beat and steering frame tracking.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input user sideband stored with beat, overridden on marked frames.

axis_frame_length_adjust_fifo.summary: Structural wrapper: an axis_frame_length_adjust core pads/truncates frames into a data FIFO while its per-frame status (pad, truncate, lengths) is queued in a header FIFO for a separate header stream.

blocks.name: Frame length adjuster
blocks.description: Child core padding short and truncating long frames per min/max

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input frame data into the length-adjust core

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid into length-adjust core

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from length-adjust core

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Input end of frame

anchors.name: length_min
anchors.why: Minimum frame length; shorter frames padded

anchors.name: length_max
anchors.why: Maximum frame length; longer frames truncated

blocks.name: Frame data FIFO
blocks.description: Buffers adjusted frame beats toward the output data stream

anchors.name: fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Adjusted frame data from core into frame FIFO

anchors.name: fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Adjusted stream valid into frame FIFO

anchors.name: fifo_axis_tready
anchors.why: Frame FIFO ready back-pressuring the core

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output frame data from frame FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output frame data valid from frame FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready draining frame FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end of frame

blocks.name: Header FIFO
blocks.description: Queues per-frame pad/truncate flags and lengths as header stream

anchors.name: status_valid
anchors.why: Per-frame status valid pushing header FIFO

anchors.name: status_ready
anchors.why: Header FIFO space for frame status

anchors.name: status_frame_length
anchors.why: Adjusted frame length stored into header FIFO

anchors.name: status_frame_original_length
anchors.why: Original frame length stored into header FIFO

anchors.name: status_frame_pad
anchors.why: Frame padded flag into header FIFO

anchors.name: status_frame_truncate
anchors.why: Frame truncated flag into header FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Header stream valid from header FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header consumer ready popping header FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_hdr_length
anchors.why: Output adjusted length from header FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_hdr_original_length
anchors.why: Output original length from header FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_hdr_pad
anchors.why: Output padded flag

anchors.name: m_axis_hdr_truncate
anchors.why: Output truncated flag
